series.name: PV1800 ECO (400V/450V high-voltage-PV off-grid hybrid)
series.notes: ONLY the rows that DIFFER from SERIES 1 are listed here, because the ECO/VPM-II family reuses the same 01-77 numbering but with WIDER meanings. Do not fall back to SERIES 1 for 03, 52 or 58 - on ECO these also cover a reversed AC L/N input and an over-hot component, which SERIES 1 does not. This series also records the ECO-specific TROUBLESHOOTING thresholds (95-150 Vac instead of 202-253 Vac). All other 01-77 rows are word-for-word the SERIES 1 text and were verified against this manual.

title.en: Battery too high OR AC L/N reversed
title.ur: Battery zyada high ya AC L/N ulta

meaning.en: On ECO this is a dual-meaning code: battery over-voltage, or the AC input L and N wires are connected in reverse.
meaning.ur: ECO par ye do matlab rakhta hai: battery over-voltage, ya AC input ke L aur N wires ulte lagi hain.

causes.en: AC input L and N are connected in reverse at the input terminal block.
causes.ur: AC input terminal block par L aur N wires ulte lagi hain.

causes.en: Battery voltage is above the safe charging limit for the pack.
causes.ur: Battery voltage pack ke safe charging limit se upar hai.

causes.en: Too many cells in series, or the wrong battery voltage is set on the LCD.
causes.ur: Series mein zyada cells hain, ya LCD par galat battery voltage set hai.

solutions.en: Switch off, isolate AC, PV and battery, then check L and N at the AC input with a multimeter before anything else.
solutions.ur: Off karke AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein, phir sab se pehle multimeter se AC input par L aur N check karein.

solutions.en: Confirm L is on the live line from the utility and N on neutral; the ECO manual's 03 row says simply 'Check AC input'.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke L utility ki live line par hai aur N neutral par, ECO manual ki 03 row kehti hai 'Check AC input'.

solutions.en: If polarity is correct, measure battery voltage and re-check the battery type and max charge voltage on the LCD.
solutions.ur: Agar polarity theek hai to battery voltage check karein aur LCD par battery type aur max charge voltage dobara check karein.

title.en: Bus too low OR component over temperature
title.ur: Bus voltage low ya component zyada garm

meaning.en: On ECO the bus is too low, or an internal component has exceeded its temperature - the SERIES 1 reading omits the temperature half.
meaning.ur: ECO par bus voltage bahut low hai ya koi internal component apne temperature limit se upar chala gaya hai, SERIES 1 ki listing mein temperature wala hissa nahi hai.

causes.en: Battery bank is deeply discharged or a string is open, so the bus cannot be built up.
causes.ur: Battery bank poori tarah discharge hai ya koi string open hai jis se bus nahi ban pata.

causes.en: An internal component is over temperature, which on ECO shares this same code.
causes.ur: Koi internal component temperature limit se upar hai jo ECO par isi code ko share karta hai.

causes.en: DC/DC boost stage or bus capacitor is faulty.
causes.ur: DC/DC boost stage ya bus capacitor kharab hai.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter with only the battery connected, PV and AC isolated.
solutions.ur: Sirf battery ke saath inverter restart karein, PV aur AC disconnect karke.

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage, the DC fuse in the battery path, and the heatsink temperature cause before assuming a board fault.
solutions.ur: Board fault assume karne se pehle battery voltage, battery path ka DC fuse aur heatsink temperature ki wajah check karein.

solutions.en: If the fault returns with a healthy battery and a cool heatsink, return the unit to the repair centre as the manual states.
solutions.ur: Agar sehatar battery aur thande heatsink par bhi fault wapas aaye to manual ke mutabiq unit repair centre bhejein.

title.en: Output voltage too low OR component over temperature
title.ur: Output voltage low ya component zyada garm

meaning.en: On ECO this also means an over-hot component, unlike SERIES 1 where 58 is output voltage only.
meaning.ur: ECO par iska matlab zyada garm component bhi hai, SERIES 1 mein 58 sirf output voltage hai.

causes.en: Battery is deeply discharged so the inverter cannot hold output voltage.
causes.ur: Battery poori tarah discharge hai jis se inverter output voltage nahi tikka sakta.

causes.en: An internal component is over temperature, which on ECO shares this same code.
causes.ur: Koi internal component temperature limit se upar hai jo ECO par isi code ko share karta hai.

causes.en: Load draws more than the unit can supply and pulls the output down.
causes.ur: Load unit ki capacity se zyada kheech raha hai aur output neeche gira raha hai.

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load and restart, then measure battery voltage before suspecting the board.
solutions.ur: Connected load kam karke restart karein, phir board par shak karne se pehle battery voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Check heatsink and fan condition, since ECO allows 58 to be a temperature event.
solutions.ur: Heatsink aur fan ki halat check karein, kyun ke ECO par 58 temperature event bhi ho sakta hai.

solutions.en: On ECO the manual's 06/58 row gives the acceptance window as 95 Vac to 150 Vac, not the SERIES 1 window - measure against 95-150 Vac.
solutions.ur: ECO par manual ki 06/58 row acceptance window 95 Vac se 150 Vac deti hai, SERIES 1 ki window nahi, 95-150 Vac ke against measure karein.

title.en: Output voltage high, ECO 95-150 Vac window
title.ur: Output voltage high, ECO ki 95-150 Vac limit

meaning.en: The ECO manual accepts inverter output between 95 Vac and 150 Vac; outside that the unit reports 06/58.
meaning.ur: ECO manual inverter output ko 95 Vac se 150 Vac ke darmiyan acceptable maanta hai, is range se bahar hone par 06/58 aata hai.

causes.en: Inverter output measured outside 95-150 Vac during the ECO acceptance check.
causes.ur: ECO acceptance check ke dauran inverter output 95-150 Vac se bahar measure hua.

causes.en: Battery over-charged, raising inverter output above the acceptable band.
causes.ur: Battery over-charged hai jis se inverter output acceptable band se upar chala gaya.

causes.en: Output voltage sense circuit has drifted on the ECO control board.
causes.ur: ECO control board par output voltage sense circuit bigad gaya hai.

solutions.en: Measure output voltage with a multimeter and compare it to the ECO window of 95-150 Vac, not to the SERIES 1 window.
solutions.ur: Output voltage multimeter se check karke ECO window 95-150 Vac se compare karein, SERIES 1 window se nahi.

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load, which is the first action the manual gives for 06/58.
solutions.ur: Connected load kam karein, ye manual 06/58 ke liye pehla action deta hai.

solutions.en: If load and battery are both correct, return the unit to the repair centre for the output sense circuit.
solutions.ur: Agar load aur battery dono theek hon to output sense circuit ke liye unit repair centre bhejein.

title.en: Fan locked while off, ECO remedy is fan swap
title.ur: Fan off state mein atka, ECO hal fan badalna

meaning.en: Fan did not run while the inverter was off; the ECO troubleshooting row gives the direct remedy.
meaning.ur: Inverter band hone par fan nahi chala, ECO troubleshooting row seedha hal deta hai.

causes.en: Cooling fan is jammed or its motor has failed.
causes.ur: Cooling fan jam hai ya uska motor kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Fan driver circuit on the ECO main board is faulty.
causes.ur: ECO main board par fan driver circuit kharab hai.

solutions.en: Switch off, isolate AC, PV and battery, then open the unit and check the fan spins freely by hand.
solutions.ur: Off karke AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein, phir unit khol ke haath se check karein ke fan azaad ghoomta hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Replace the fan - the ECO manual's 01 troubleshooting row states 'Replace the fan.'
solutions.ur: Fan replace karein, ECO manual ki 01 troubleshooting row kehti hai 'Replace the fan.'

solutions.en: If a new fan still triggers 01, the fan drive circuit on the main board needs workshop repair.
solutions.ur: Naya fan lagane par bhi 01 aaye to main board ka fan drive circuit workshop repair maangta hai.

meaning.en: An inverter component exceeded 90 degrees C and the unit shut down.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka koi component 90 degree C se upar chala gaya aur unit band ho gaya.

causes.en: Air flow of the unit is blocked by dust or a closed cabinet.
causes.ur: Unit ka hawa ka rasta dust ya band cabinet se block hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature is too high for the installation room.
causes.ur: Installation kamre ka ambient temperature zyada hai.

solutions.en: Switch off and isolate AC, PV and battery, then check whether air flow is blocked or ambient is too high, as the ECO manual directs.
solutions.ur: Off karke AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein, phir ECO manual ke mutabiq check karein ke hawa ka rasta band hai ya ambient zyada hai.

solutions.en: Clean the fan and anti-dust mesh and restore the 200 mm side and 300 mm top clearances.
solutions.ur: Fan aur anti-dust mesh saaf karein aur 200 mm side, 300 mm upar clearance wapas karein.

solutions.en: Measure the NTC at the heatsink with a multimeter and replace it if it is open or far from its marked value.
solutions.ur: Heatsink ka NTC multimeter se check karein aur khula ya marked value se door ho to replace karein.

meaning.en: AC output or load wiring is shorted; the ECO manual's remedy is to check wiring and remove the abnormal load.
meaning.ur: AC output ya load wiring short hai, ECO manual ka hal hai wiring check karna aur abnormal load hatana.

causes.en: Load wiring is shorted or a copper strand has bridged L and N.
causes.ur: Load wiring short hai ya copper ka taar L aur N ko jor raha hai.

causes.en: A load's internal insulation has failed.
causes.ur: Kisi load ki internal insulation kharab ho gayi hai.

solutions.en: Switch off and isolate AC, PV and battery before opening the unit or touching wiring.
solutions.ur: Unit kholne ya wiring chhoone se pehle off karke AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Check if wiring is connected right and remove abnormal load, exactly as the ECO 05 row instructs.
solutions.ur: ECO ki 05 row ki tarah check karein ke wiring theek connected hai ya nahi aur abnormal load hata dein.

solutions.en: Disconnect loads one by one to find the shorted circuit, then re-tighten all AC terminal screws.
solutions.ur: Short wala circuit dhoondne ke liye loads ek ek karke disconnect karein, phir saare AC terminal screws dobara tight karein.

meaning.en: The unit was overloaded past 110 percent until the overload timer expired.
meaning.ur: Unit 110 percent se zyada overload hua jab tak overload timer khatam nahi hua.

causes.en: Too many appliances connected, or a motor surge on start.
causes.ur: Bohat zyada appliances lagi hain, ya motor start par surge le raha hai.

causes.en: Air conditioner or fridge restarted without its delay time.
causes.ur: Air conditioner ya fridge ne apna delay time rakhe baghair dobara start kar diya.

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load by switching off some equipment, as the ECO 07 row directs.
solutions.ur: Kuch equipment band kar ke connected load kam karein, jaisa ECO ki 07 row kehti hai.

solutions.en: Keep a 2-3 minute restart delay for air conditioners so refrigerant can settle.
solutions.ur: Air conditioner ke liye 2-3 minute ka restart delay rakhein taake refrigerant settle ho sake.

solutions.en: Verify the total running load in watts on the LCD against the model's rated power.
solutions.ur: LCD par kul chal rahe load watts ko model ki rated power se verify karein.

meaning.en: The ECO manual groups these four numbers into one troubleshooting row and calls the cause 'Internal components failed'.
meaning.ur: ECO manual in chaar numbers ko aik troubleshooting row mein group karta hai aur wajah 'Internal components failed' batata hai.

causes.en: One or more power devices or control components on the main board have failed.
causes.ur: Main board par aik ya kai power devices ya control components kharab ho gaye hain.

causes.en: Soft-start, bus sensing or control current sensing circuit has failed.
causes.ur: Soft-start, bus sensing ya control current sensing circuit kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery and measure the devices the ECO manual points to for each code, starting with the DC fuse and boost module.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery disconnect karke ECO manual ki taraf bataye gaye devices check karein, DC fuse aur boost module se shuru karein.

solutions.en: Return to repair center - this is the ECO manual's explicit instruction for this group.
solutions.ur: Repair center bhejein, ye is group ke liye ECO manual ka saaf instruction hai.

solutions.en: If one IGBT or MOSFET is burnt, the manufacturer advises replacing all devices in that bridge, not just one.
solutions.ur: Agar aik IGBT ya MOSFET jal gaya ho to manufacturer kehta hai ke us bridge ke tamam devices replace karein, sirf aik nahi.

title.en: Over current or surge, ECO remedy
title.ur: Over current ya surge, ECO hal

meaning.en: Output over-current or a surge event tripped protection; the ECO remedy is to reduce the connected load.
meaning.ur: Output over-current ya surge event ne protection chala di, ECO hal connected load kam karna hai.

causes.en: Motor or compressor inrush current on start.
causes.ur: Start par motor ya compressor ka inrush current.

causes.en: Too many loads connected, or AC output shorted.
causes.ur: Bohat zyada loads lagi hain ya AC output short hai.

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load by switching off equipment, as the ECO 51 row directs.
solutions.ur: Equipment band kar ke connected load kam karein, jaisa ECO ki 51 row kehti hai.

solutions.en: Compare the load's rated current with the inverter's output current and move large motors to a separate unit.
solutions.ur: Load ka rated current inverter ke output current se compare karein aur bade motors alag unit par le jaayein.

solutions.en: If the fault returns with a reduced load, inspect the AC output wiring for a short with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Load kam karne par bhi fault aaye to multimeter se AC output wiring mein short check karein.

meaning.en: The manual describes this as output voltage being unbalanced, meaning the inverter bridge is not switching symmetrically.
meaning.ur: Manual isay output voltage unbalanced kehta hai, yaani inverter bridge symmetrical switch nahi kar raha.

causes.en: One inverter IGBT or MOSFET is damaged, so its half bridge is asymmetric.
causes.ur: Aik inverter IGBT ya MOSFET damage hua hai jis se uska half bridge asymmetric ho gaya.

causes.en: DC is leaking into the AC output through a failed snubber or filter capacitor.
causes.ur: Kharab snubber ya filter capacitor ke zariye AC output mein DC leak ho raha hai.

solutions.en: Switch off and isolate AC, PV and battery, then measure DC volts on the AC output with the meter set to DC.
solutions.ur: Off karke AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein, phir meter DC par set karke AC output par DC voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Check the output snubber and filter capacitors on the main board for short or open.
solutions.ur: Main board par output snubber aur filter capacitors ko short ya open check karein.

solutions.en: Replace all devices in the affected bridge if any power device is found damaged.
solutions.ur: Agar koi power device damage nikle to us bridge ke tamam devices replace karein.

title.en: Battery not connected right or fuse burnt
title.ur: Battery theek connected nahi ya fuse jal gaya

meaning.en: The ECO troubleshooting row states the battery is not connected right or the fuse is burnt.
meaning.ur: ECO troubleshooting row kehti hai ke battery theek connected nahi ya fuse jal chuka hai.

causes.en: Battery cable is not connected right, or a ring terminal has come off.
causes.ur: Battery cable theek connected nahi ya ring terminal nikal gaya hai.

causes.en: The DC fuse in the battery path is burnt.
causes.ur: Battery path ka DC fuse jal chuka hai.

causes.en: A battery string is open because a cell failed.
causes.ur: Battery string khuli hai kyun ke aik cell kharab ho gaya.

solutions.en: Check battery is not connected right first, then inspect the DC fuse with a multimeter continuity test.
solutions.ur: Pehle check karein ke battery theek connected hai ya nahi, phir DC fuse ko multimeter continuity test se check karein.

solutions.en: Replace a burnt fuse with the exact same amp rating and type, never a higher rating.
solutions.ur: Jala hua fuse bilkul usi amp rating aur type se lagayein, kabhi higher rating na dein.

solutions.en: If the battery is connected well, return to repair center, which is the ECO manual's stated action.
solutions.ur: Agar battery theek connected hai to repair center bhejein, ye ECO manual ka bataya hua action hai.
